description: Registered speech voices for an OS release and an accept-languages list. The languages key is the resolved accept-languages string; the empty-string key is always present and leaves the speech section absent so host providers remain in effect. Only localService true voices appear here. The network voices Chromium lists are served by its network speech synthesis component against a Google endpoint and need build-time keys, so they are a build capability and not a profile value (docs/FINGERPRINTS.md section 8).
label: voices

options.note: The 180 local voices measured on the Apple M4 Max reference host. macOS lists every installed voice regardless of the UI language, which is why the set does not vary with the accept-languages list. Only localService true voices appear here. The network voices Chromium lists are served by its network speech synthesis component against a Google endpoint and need build-time keys, so they are a build capability and not a profile value (docs/FINGERPRINTS.md section 8). The nineteen network voices a Chrome-branded build registers. They are a browser property, not a device one: both this project's Windows capture and its macOS capture record the same nineteen names in the same order, so they belong to every persona this fork serves rather than to a machine. Patch 0125 speaks a listed voice through a real local provider when this build has no network speech key, so listing them no longer means listing a voice that cannot speak.
